title.description: Short slide title (max ~6 words), shown at the top of the slide and in the navigation menu.

question.description: The question stem (plain text), e.g. a description the student must match to one of the images.

path.description: Exact path of one of the supplied source images, e.g. 'images/cutting_geometry.png'.

alt_text.description: Concise description of what the image shows, for screen-reader users.

image.description: The image shown as this option. Its alt_text describes what is visible without naming the answer (it is read out to screen-reader users).

feedback.description: Shown when the student selects this option: explains the visual features that make it right or wrong.

options.description: 2-4 image options, each a different supplied image; at least one correct and at least one incorrect. Students see them labelled A, B, C, D in this order.

all_correct.description: Shown when the student gets everything right. One sentence that reinforces the key idea.

not_all_correct.description: Shown otherwise. One sentence that points the student back to the key idea without giving away the answers.
